main_text.p: iis expressum, quantum posteris foret necessarium, ac Deo commemorare placuit pro liberrimo ac sapientissimo suo consilio; non autem quicquid utcunque utilitatem praestare posset. Neque dubium videtur, quin illi pro exercitiis Religionis secundùm cultum institutum, diem aliquem certum hebdomadarium habuerint observandum; licet is forte aliquandò & alicubi in neglectum abierit. Eò autem minùs dubitandum; quòd apud Gentiles etiàm varios Septimus dies sacer fuerit habitus.
main_text.head: II. Opponens urget: Enosh potuit invocare nomen Domini, & Abraham sacrificare: non stato Sabbati recursû; sed rariùs, vel frequentiùs, pro datâ opportunitatis ansâ. Quódsi in Sabbato neglexisset Jacob gregis Labanici custodiam, aut minuissent Israëlitæ sub Pharaone lateris aut stipulæ pensum; nec ille rixas, aut illi fustidineas ferri-crepinas Insulas impendio evasissent. Ex praescripto autem sabbati zantium, quo se verterent? Sabbathum observas? Certa crux. negligis? Justissima impendet Deiob Legem violatam indigna-

page.notes: Printed page number "203" at head right; "16" at foot is a signature-like mark, read as "I 6" and treated as page furniture. Some words are obscured by stains, notably "neglexisset" and "custodiam". "Deiob" and "sabbati zantium" are doubtful readings; "Deiob" may be a printing error. "Sabbathum" is printed as such.
